events.body: Mowi ASA (MHGVY) reports strong quarterly performance with record revenues, strategic cost-saving initiatives, and optimistic growth forecasts for 2026.

events.title: Norway’s Mowi slips as seafood firm flags underwhelming operating earnings
events.body: Investing.com - Mowi has said it will post fourth-quarter operational income below recent market forecasts, sending shares down by more than 2% in mid-morning European trading.
